name: iDempiere
description: Open source ERP and CRM platform for distribution, accounting, and manufacturing built on OSGi.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: idempiere
      DB_USER: adempiere
      DB_PASS: {{env.DB_PASS}}
      DB_ADMIN_PASS: {{env.DB_ADMIN_PASS}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/opt/idempiere/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: adempiere
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASS}}
      POSTGRES_DB: idempiere
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
